hook: I want every AI flag in an audit to have a clear human decision behind it

builtFor.context: VECTRA's portal brings participants, assessors, QA staff and board executives into one place, with AI verification along the way. VECTRA's own writing sets a high bar for evidence; the portal should carry it.

opportunities.title: Evidence Review
opportunities.body: Claim and evidence side by side for every AI flag.

opportunities.title: A decision trail
opportunities.body: Uphold, edit or dismiss, with a logged reason.

opportunities.title: Honest conclusions
opportunities.body: Board views that say what isn't covered.

body: I designed Youverify's Transaction Monitoring MVP end to end: compliance analysts reviewing alerts a system raised, with evidence and a clear next step. That's the same human-in-the-loop problem as VECTRA's portal.
I built a component library and design system at Foodlify that cut developer onboarding by 45%, which is the rebrand and component work this role asks for.

bring.title: Compliance and AI review
bring.body: KYC and transaction-monitoring tools for regulated businesses.

bring.title: Design systems
bring.body: Components, tokens and documentation engineers can build from fast.

bring.title: Remote and async
bring.body: Years working remotely with distributed product and engineering teams.

systemsGets: Someone who turns a rebrand into tokens, components and documented specs the engineering team can ship from.

opportunity.title: Evidence Review
opportunity.problem: AI flags inconsistencies across audit reports and evidence, but reviewers have to open documents to check them, and boards need conclusions that state their limits.
opportunity.solution: Claim and evidence side by side, uphold, edit or dismiss with a logged reason, and board conclusions that say what isn't covered.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how each persona uses the portal, then shipping one improvement and starting the rebrand audit.

days.body: Meet the team. Walk through the portal as a participant, assessor, QA reviewer and board member.
Sit with QA staff reviewing real AI flags; note where they slow down.
Audit the component library against the new brand.
Design the review screen and spec the components.
Share the prototype, specs and a plan for the rebrand rollout.

ask: I'd love to help VECTRA make AI verification clear and trustworthy for every persona.
